title: Adhyaya 8: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 8.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 8.

verses.original: धर्म एव हतो हन्ति धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः । तस्माद्धर्मो न हन्तव्यो मा नो धर्मो हतोऽवधीत् ॥
verses.transliteration: dharma eva hato hanti dharmo rakṣati rakṣitaḥ | tasmāddharmo na hantavyo mā no dharmo hato'vadhīt ||
verses.translation: Dharma, when violated, destroys; Dharma, when protected, protects. Therefore, Dharma must never be violated, lest violated Dharma strike us down.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The immortal judicial maxim: righteousness upheld becomes an impregnable shield; righteousness betrayed ruins society.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Dharma, when violated, destroys; Dharma, when protected, protects. Therefore, Dharma must never be violated, lest violated Dharma strike us down.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 8: The immortal judicial maxim: righteousness upheld becomes an impregnable shield; righteousness betrayed ruins society.

verses.original: सत्येन लभ्यते कीर्तिः सत्येन लभते गतिम् । सत्यमेव परं ब्रह्म सत्यं धर्मः सनातनः ॥
verses.transliteration: satyena labhyate kīrtiḥ satyena labhate gatim | satyameva paraṁ brahma satyaṁ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
verses.translation: Through truth renown is attained; through truth the highest state is reached; Truth alone is supreme Brahman, and Truth is the eternal Dharma.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Judicial integrity requires unswerving fidelity to truth in testimonies and rulings.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Through truth renown is attained; through truth the highest state is reached; Truth alone is supreme Brahman, and Truth is the eternal Dharma.
